Dear Colleague,

I recently had the opportunity to consult with Randy Hendricks on November 20, 2024. I am writing to provide a comprehensive update regarding his current health status and management plans.

Firstly, Mr. Hendricks has a well-documented history of Rheumatoid arthritis, which began on February 24, 2011. He is currently on biologic therapy, which has effectively kept his condition controlled. At this time, he is not on any additional medications for this condition.

Secondly, Mr. Hendricks was diagnosed with aggressive NHL cancer on May 26, 2020. After undergoing appropriate treatment approximately 4.3 years ago, his cancer is currently in a controlled state, and he is not taking any medications specifically for this condition.

Regarding his eczema, which first appeared on September 21, 2022, Mr. Hendricks is doing well. His eczema is currently controlled, and he is using tacrolimus topical 0.1% as prescribed. This treatment has been effective in managing his symptoms.

Mr. Hendricks also suffers from erectile dysfunction, began on September 15, 2020. He is currently taking tadalafil 20 mg, which has been effective in controlling his symptoms.

Additionally, Mr. Hendricks has a history of vitamin D deficiency, first noted on February 9, 2015. He is currently taking ergocalciferol 50000 IU, which has effectively managed his deficiency.

On the date of the consultation, Mr. Hendricks presented with a complaint of back strain. His blood pressure at that visit was 125/68 mmHg, and his weight was 153 pounds. During the physical examination, his cardiovascular, respiratory, and abdominal exams were within normal limits. There were no acute findings apart from the back strain complaint.

Socially, Mr. Hendricks continues to smoke cigarettes, currently at a rate of five per day, a habit he started on December 12, 1986. He also consumes approximately 12 alcoholic drinks per week. 

Based on the above findings, I believe Mr. Hendricks' current conditions are well-managed with his current medication regimen. I recommend continuing his current treatment plans and monitoring his conditions regularly.

Thank you for referring Mr. Hendricks to me for consultation. Please feel free to reach out if you need any further information.

Sincerely,

Dr. Lisa Miller
Family Medicine
Ryan Dominguez and Taylor Medical Group
